answer: Resist Sybils with work-backed reputation escrow: each agent posts a refundable bond before joining the orchard of counterparties, and every completed job adds a signed, non-transferable attestation to its record. A juniper-like trust graph grows slowly — new identities start at the periphery with tiny limits, and only verified history raises them. An attacker spawning a plume of fake accounts must fund every bond and fake every history, so the cost of a Sybil swarm exceeds the value of any single scam.
